reasons.C: Balanced, unhurried sentences with an urbane, dry irony that surfaces at the end of each paragraph, like the passage's; formal diction and a restrained semicolon fit, though the one-line closing paragraph is a little modern.
reasons.B: Has the right period register and ironic stance, but many short, clipped sentences break the rhythm, and the vase simile and sheriff question push the wit harder than the passage does.
reasons.A: Plain, modern, explanatory prose ('one more thread worth pulling', 'convenient edge') with even, flat rhythm; it states the irony outright where the author leaves it implied.
